entities.name: EPHB4
observations: EphB4 activation by clustered ephrin-B2/Fc was associated with reduced neointimal hyperplasia in cultured human saphenous-vein rings.

entities.name: ephrin-B2/Fc
observations: Clustered ephrin-B2/Fc at 2 μg/mL was used as an EphB4-activating ligand in human saphenous-vein organ culture for 14 days.

entities.name: human saphenous vein
observations: Discarded adult human saphenous-vein rings were cultured ex vivo; ephrin-B2/Fc reduced the neointima/media ratio from 0.726 ± 0.142 to 0.630 ± 0.132, matched n=19, P=.017.

entities.name: neointimal hyperplasia
observations: In cultured human saphenous-vein rings, EphB4 activation with ephrin-B2/Fc reduced the culture-associated neointima/media ratio by approximately 13% versus untreated cultured veins.

entities.name: PMID:25446283
observations: A 2016 Journal of Vascular Surgery study reported that ephrin-B2/Fc-mediated EphB4 activation reduced neointimal hyperplasia in cultured human saphenous vein.
